neobrutal-ui: Base UI powered neobrutalist design-system base.
accordion: A vertically stacked set of collapsible content sections.
alert: A prominent message for status updates, notices, and warnings.
alert-dialog: A modal confirmation dialog for important or destructive actions.
avatar: An image or fallback that identifies a person or entity.
badge: A compact label for statuses, categories, and metadata.
breadcrumb: A navigation trail that shows the current page hierarchy.
button: An interactive control that triggers an action or navigation.
calendar: A date picker calendar with single and range selection support.
card: A bordered container for grouping related content and actions.
carousel: A scrollable collection of content with previous and next controls.
chart: Composable Recharts helpers with neobrutalist styling and legends.
checkbox: A control for toggling one or more independent selections.
collapsible: An expandable region that reveals or hides related content.
command: A searchable command palette for actions and navigation.
context-menu: A contextual action menu opened with a secondary pointer action.
dialog: A modal overlay for focused content, forms, and actions.
drawer: A panel that slides in from the edge of the viewport.
dropdown-menu: A button-triggered menu for actions, choices, and nested options.
form: Accessible form helpers with React Hook Form and Zod validation.
hover-card: A preview card that appears when a linked element is hovered.
image-card: A neobrutalist card for presenting an image with supporting content.
input: A styled text field for collecting short-form user input.
input-group: A text input composed with buttons, icons, or inline controls.
input-otp: A segmented input for one-time passwords and verification codes.
label: An accessible text label for a form control.
marquee: A continuously scrolling row for logos, quotes, or featured content.
menubar: A horizontal application menu with nested commands and shortcuts.
navigation-menu: A responsive site navigation menu with expandable link panels.
pagination: Navigation controls for moving between pages of content.
popover: A floating panel for contextual content and lightweight controls.
progress: A visual indicator of task or process completion.
radio-group: A set of mutually exclusive options for selecting one value.
resizable: Adjustable panel groups with draggable resize handles.
scroll-area: A custom scrollable viewport with styled scrollbars.
select: A dropdown control for choosing one value from a list.
separator: A visual divider for separating related content groups.
sheet: A modal panel that enters from a configurable screen edge.
sidebar: A responsive, collapsible application sidebar with navigation primitives.
skeleton: A placeholder that communicates content is loading.
slider: A draggable control for selecting a value or range.
sonner: A toast notification provider styled for neobrutalist interfaces.
switch: A binary control for turning a setting on or off.
table: Semantic table primitives for structured rows and columns.
tabs: A tabbed interface for switching between related content panels.
textarea: A multiline text field for collecting longer user input.
tooltip: A concise text hint shown when an element is hovered or focused.
data-table: A sortable, filterable data table recipe built with TanStack Table.
blog-template: A focused blog archive with search and readable post rows.
portfolio-template: A minimal portfolio with an introduction, selected work, and contact links.
cms-template: A compact CMS for finding, editing, and publishing posts.
link-hub-template: A compact profile and link grid for projects, social profiles, and contact.
